topPRs.author: NubsCarson
topPRs.body:
Closes #19868.

This refactor makes the personal Shared agent run the canonical edge Todo plugin, persists Todo mutations exactly once, and carries Todo rows plus replay authority through identity convergence and Shared-to-Dedicated cutover.

## Scope

- Run `@elizaos/plugin-todos/edge` inside the genuine Shared `AgentRuntime`.
- Store Todos and immutable mutation receipts in control-plane Postgres with tenant-qualified scopes.
- Replay a repeated keyed mutation as the original no-op receipt; reject changed semantics under the same key.
- Preserve Todo IDs, parent links, mutation IDs, receipt IDs, and replay authority during phone-to-Telegram convergence and Shared-to-Dedicated cutover.
- Keep reminder delivery on the scheduling subsystem; Todos do not create a second scheduler.
- Publish a UI-free Node/Worker package contract and build every imported edge dependency before Cloud shared typecheck.

## Final merged candidate

Final PR head: `db1701c3d336eaeb30a38083ad492888a98ba324`  
Merge commit: `d4845d272c16e65a39433ad3ebe92799afeadfcf`  
Final base: `origin/develop@e65ce00a2e33ae46ebdad6eae36115162aebf6e2`  
Shared final tree: `0f14ad87ecb6fe9e677d9e114230701e3df1c47c`

- JSON-RPC IDs are connection-local correlation only. Unkeyed calls receive fresh durable message IDs, so a restarted counter cannot replay an old Todo mutation. Keyed calls derive stable durable identities from `clientMessageId`.
- Shared Todo migrations follow develop's `0205_identity_links_transport_source`: `0206_shared_todos.sql` and `0207_todo_mutation_ledger.sql`.
- The packed edge-export contract permits a real clean package build instead of failing on a CI-speed assumption.
- Turbo builds scheduling, Todos, and web-search edge dependencies before `@elizaos/cloud-shared#typecheck`, removing clean-run ordering races.

Shaw rebased and merged the reviewed series. Independent post-merge audit found all **35/35** reviewed patches range-diff equivalent. Shaw's only additional patch formats one existing `turbo.json` array; normalized JSON is unchanged. The final PR head and merge commit share the exact tree above. All Todo migration and journal blobs are byte-identical to the reviewed candidate and ordered after `0205` as `0206` and `0207`.

## Validation

Reviewed patch gates (all 35 patches are byte-equivalent in the final merge):

- Root `bun run verify`: **351/351 tasks PASS**, including repository policy audits.

- Independent post-merge audit: **P0/P1/P2/P3 none**, clean diff, no-swap PASS, **35/35** reviewed patches range-diff equivalent, and final head/merge tree identity confirmed.

Fresh proof on exact merge commit `d4845d272c16e65a39433ad3ebe92799afeadfcf` used genuine `@elizaos/core/edge` `AgentRuntime`, `@elizaos/plugin-todos/edge`, and `createTodosSqlStore` over file-backed PGlite with direct Cerebras `gemma-4-31b`:

- **7/7** provider exchanges returned HTTP 200.
- Create applied, list read back the exact Todo, and replaying the same stable Telegram client ID returned the same Todo and receipt as `outcome=noop`, `replayed=true`.
- Final database state was exactly one Todo and one mutation-ledger row.
- Todo: `a6cf0af9-b08c-4e1a-ab48-e414981c933f`.
- Mutation/commit: `45559b6f-aa44-4fc2-ad88-2065c19f967b`.
- Idempotency key: `todos:v1:telegram:shared-todos:d4845d27:create-001:0`.
- Request digest: `ba8b67e97790ea31afad3ecef70145794729a1b5e87a513da8bffae720f4e818`.

## Summary
